name: DailySpace
description:
Daily Space is your ultimate personal productivity and life operating system designed to build unbreakable discipline. Move beyond fleeting motivation with structured tools tailored for high performance.
Key Features:
Dashboard &amp; Daily Progress: Track your daily task completion rate, active streak score, and discipline level.
Routine Planner &amp; Tasks: Organize your daily schedule across work, fitness, health, and growth with priority management.
Advanced Habit Tracker: Build daily recurring habits and watch your consistency streaks grow.
Goal Management: Set major strategic objectives and check off progress milestones.
Focus Timer: Eliminate distractions with a robust deep work countdown timer and custom intervals.
Self-Control Center: Take on daily discipline challenges and enforce personal rules.
Achievements &amp; Rewards: Earn XP, level up your commander rank, and unlock milestone badges.
Gamified Brain Gym, Calendar, and SPACE AI Assistant (Available in PRO).
